entities.summary: Bruce Island is an island in Franz Josef Land, Russia. It lies in southwestern Franz Josef Land, roughly 8.6 kilometres (5.3 mi) southeast of the southeastern coast of Zemlya Georga across the Nightingale Channel, and about 11 kilometres (6.8 mi) northwest of Northbrook Island across the Miers Channel. It has an area of 191 square kilometres (74 sq mi). The highest point of the island is about 301 metres (988 ft).
